atomicity: Single same-filesystem rename publication; no multi-file transaction claim
consistency_claim: Acknowledged immutable publication survives one active MDS process crash; exact fresh-client readback
ack_boundary: ceph_fsync + close + rename + ceph_sync_fs, then fsynced external-pool witness
idempotency: Unique run/sequence paths; no automatic application mutation retries
timeout_semantics: Native calls can stall beyond intended phase; external supervision does not prove a mutation failed
read_path: One persistent historical reader through fault; new connections reconcile all old and live ACKs after recovery
